init_processor: initialize a MiniCPMV4_6Processor with an image processor, video processor, and tokenizer
call_processor_with_images: process text and images through MiniCPMV4_6Processor to get tokenized input_ids and pixel values
call_processor_with_videos: process text and videos through MiniCPMV4_6Processor to get tokenized input_ids with video placeholders
post_process_outputs: post process generated token outputs using post_process_image_text_to_text to decode model responses
configure_processor_kwargs: configure MiniCPMV4_6ProcessorKwargs to set padding, return_tensors, and downsample mode defaults
